title: Ruby Cocoon is still a work in progress, but things are changing fast!
author: invot
selftext:
I was honestly a little surprised by how negatively people responded to the screenshots I shared. Maybe I'm sharing too early, but I'm excited about what I've been making and wanted to show it off!

The game is still a long way from finished. The UI is rough, the art style isn't fully realized, and I'm constantly reworking things to make everything feel more cohesive. It's been a LOT of work, and I'm very aware there's still plenty to improve.

Even this video, which I made earlier today, is already outdated. Things move incredibly fast with AI, which is both a blessing and a curse.

I'm hoping this video helps show just how much things can change in a short amount of time. I'm not pretending the game looks perfect, but I'm genuinely proud of what I've accomplished so far. I really enjoy playing this game and I hope other people will get the chance to play it as well!

replies.author: invot
replies.body:
I would agree! I think I went from \~35% complete to 45% in this video, and I think the hardest parts are still ahead of me. I'm likely sharing way too early into the process because with every frame of that video I'm cringing about something that still need to be touched up. 

If you have any specific feedback I'd honestly love to hear it!

comments.author: Putrid_Clue_2127
comments.body: Honestly it looks like a cozy little gameplay adventure. Some of its starting to look more polished and stylized. I think getting the plain white menus down and some little improvements to the UI will go a long way.

replies.author: invot
replies.body: Yeah, the UI has been such an odd struggle. Mostly because Claude loves to break all the rules I give it about HUD sizing and location. It also loves to add useless buttons all over the place. But once I got things arranged how I like it, and defined the rules enough for Claude not to go rouge, the styling just fell into place.

comments.author: ThinkTyler
comments.body:
Looks fun! Definitely needs some polish but also I can tell you’ve put a ton of work in it already. Keep at it!

I think one thing that would be good to share is like teaser videos, going over more so the premise of the game, story, game loop and all that, ya know?  Instead of just random battles and moments, tell more of a story with text on screen. Claude can make these for you, check out my last post to see what I mean

replies.author: invot
replies.body: Oh absolutely! I've filmed a couple videos about technical topics that I'm waffling on posting. I think gameplay mechanics would be a more interesting topic. The battle mechanics were completely reworked somewhere around 8 times now, for example. I'd have a lot to say about that.
